summary: Out-of-state male skier lost control and collided with a tree with considerable force on the American Flyer intermediate run at Copper Mountain Resort; crash witnessed ~10:45 a.m., no other skiers/riders involved. The helmeted skier was treated by Copper Mountain Ski Patrol and transported to the CommonSpirit Emergency and Urgent Care facility near the base of the mountain, where he was pronounced dead. Summit County Sheriff's Office conducting independent investigation; coroner to determine official cause/manner.
location: American Flyer run, Copper Mountain Resort
responding_agency: Summit County Sheriff's Office; Copper Mountain Ski Patrol
